Subject: MPA kickoff & eval cadence for Nebula (GCP private offer)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the good conversation yesterday. Per our call, I’m proposing a concise mutual action plan (MPA) so we can align on the technical evaluation, procurement milestones, and the billing path for the GCP private offer. The goal is a clean acceptance and invoice route so finance can process the private offer without custom work.

Quick proposed cadence: 
- Week 0 (next 5 business days): Delivery of MAP spreadsheet + SOC2 evidence stub (I’ve attached a draft).
- Week 1–2: Technical acceptance run (smoke tests + performance spot checks on your baseline prompts).
- Week 3: Procurement approval + PO issuance (private-offer flow through GCP Marketplace).
- Week 4: DocuSign and billing activation (first invoice aligned to private offer terms).

Notes / asks for Nebula: please confirm procurement contact (you cc’d procurement@nebula earlier — correct?), and any internal finance constraints (chargeback codes, invoice-to entity). We can compress the timeline if legal approves the private-offer terms early.

Attached: Nebula_MAP_v1.xlsx (MPA template), Nebula_SOC2_summary.pdf (summary).

If this looks OK I’ll circulate a finalized MAP and add a short mutual acceptance checklist for the tech team.

Thanks —
Mina

Hi all —

From the technical side I sketched a short acceptance checklist (embedded below) that maps to our MAP timeline. This is intentionally minimal — we want the eval to be deterministic and fast.

Acceptance checklist (target run: Week 1–2)
- Test harness: run 3 representative prompt families across 1k tokens, 100 concurrent sessions (expected latency P95 < 450ms).
- Quality gates: sample of 200 responses against Nebula reference prompts; automatic regression check (no more than 5% drop in baseline relevance score).
- Security check: response sanitization on PII prompts + ensure KV-cache isolation with private-offer deployment.
- Billing validation: sample request trace that maps a single test invocation to a marketplace billing event (we’ll perform with a sandbox invoice).

Timeline (compressed option if legal signs terms within 48 hours):
- Day 0: MAP finalized + technical test dataset shared.
- Day 1–3: Redwood runs smoke + performance; Nebula runs functional checks.
- Day 4: joint review; if green, we hand to procurement for PO.

I’ll provide a small Cloud Shell snippet and a GUIDed harness you can run in Nebula’s GCP project to gather traces. Let me know who on your infra team I should share temporary test creds with.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
